title: Health Resort east wing room 328 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks the door of room 328 in the East wing of the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort east wing room 328 key (E328 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium east wing room 328.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Connects to a utility room through the balcony.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in the Quest Wet Job - Part 5

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text:
- On a table on the island, next to an outboard motor

- On a desk inside the hydroelectric power station.

- In a key rack in west wing room 202 at the health resort.

- On the floor below a key rack in the utility room next to west wing room 227 at the health resort.

- In the key rack near the central stairs on the second floor of the east wing at the health resort.

- On the floor below a key rack near the central stairs on the third floor of the east wing at the health resort.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The third floor, room 328 of the East Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Room 328:
  - 1× LEDX spawn
  - 1× Graphics card spawn
  - 2× Electronic Spawns
  - 1× Weapon Spawn
  - 1× PC block
  - 1× Sport bag
  - Loose loot (Weapon mods, Currency)
- Connected utility room:
  - One table with Valuables and Roubles
